**STEP 1 - Scene:** A breakfast or lunch plate photographed from above at a slight angle. It holds cottage cheese, roasted sweet potato, fresh fruit, and a small plate at the left edge that is not part of this meal.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** White rectangular dinner plate, about 26 cm across the long side. Area ≈ 530 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** Cottage cheese (curds), roasted sweet potato cubes, strawberries, dark grapes/blueberries, and melon cubes (cantaloupe/honeydew). No visible oil or sauce.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Cottage cheese ~45% (239 cm²), sweet potato ~12% (64 cm²), melon ~8% (42 cm²), strawberries ~4% (21 cm²), grapes/blueberries ~3% (16 cm²). Total food coverage ≈ 72%.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Cheese 239 cm² × ~1.2 cm ≈ 287 ml; sweet potato 64 × 1.5 ≈ 95 ml; melon 42 × 2 ≈ 85 ml; strawberries 21 × 1 ≈ 21 ml; grapes 16 × 1.5 ≈ 24 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Cheese 287 × 0.95 ≈ 250 g; sweet potato 95 × 0.6 ≈ 57 g; melon 85 × 0.6 ≈ 50 g; strawberries ≈ 30 g; grapes/blueberries ≈ 25 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Cottage cheese 250 g × 98 kcal/100 g ≈ 245 kcal; sweet potato 57 g × 90 ≈ 51 kcal; melon 50 g × 34 ≈ 17 kcal; strawberries 30 g × 32 ≈ 10 kcal; grapes/blueberries 25 g × 69 ≈ 17 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 410 g total and about 340 kcal. That fits a plate about 70% covered with a large mound of cottage cheese and a modest amount of fruit and vegetable pieces.
